meta.topic: 学习方法、考试复盘、有效求助、借还资料与教育阶段
meta.courseModel: 三次课：介绍笔记方法 → 复盘考试并清楚求助 → 归还资料并完成学习成长分享
meta.sourceTextPolicy: 四篇教材中文和拼音逐行保留；课文三“我看重”依据教材附注、同一行拼音 kàn bu dǒng 和英文 don’t understand 校订为“我看不懂”；课文四使用邮件布局；英文译文、教育体系说明、练习和任务属于教学扩展。

editorialNotes.source: 书上第五页的这个对话我看重，小雪也不明白。
editorialNotes.formal: 书上第五页的这个对话我看不懂，小雪也不明白。
editorialNotes.evidence: 教材附注明确实际应为“我看不懂”；同一行拼音为 kàn bu dǒng，英文为 don’t understand。

pedagogy.speakingParticipation: 主观任务提供基础、标准、挑战三档支架；真实考试分数可以不公开，每位组员都要表达。
pedagogy.cultureFactPolicy: 教育体系只按教材概括为一般情况；比较不同地区时尊重制度和个人路径差异。

1.title: 认真记笔记

grammar.title: “把”字句（1）：位置改变
grammar.scene: Identify a specific object, then say where an action moves or places it.
grammar.structure: 主语 +（不 / 没 / 能愿动词）+ 把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 在 / 到 + 地点
grammar.explanation: “把”前置确定的宾语，后面说明动作让它的位置发生变化；否定词和能愿动词放在“把”前。

grammar.title: 固定格式“在……上 / 中 / 下”

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.hanzi: 我看过你的笔记，记得非常清楚。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kànguo nǐ de bǐjì, jì de fēicháng qīngchu.
lines.english: I have seen your notes; they are very clear.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 老师写在黑板上的题都很重要，所以我都会把这些题都记在本子上。
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiě zài hēibǎn shang de tí dōu hěn zhòngyào, suǒyǐ wǒ dōu huì bǎ zhèxiē tí dōu jì zài běnzi shang.
lines.english: The questions the teacher writes on the board are important, so I copy them into my notebook.

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.hanzi: 你说得对。我没有记笔记的习惯。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì. Wǒ méiyǒu jì bǐjì de xíguàn.
lines.english: You are right. I do not have the habit of taking notes.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 笔记挺重要的，我每天写作业以前，都要看一遍。
lines.pinyin: Bǐjì tǐng zhòngyào de, wǒ měitiān xiě zuòyè yǐqián, dōu yào kàn yí biàn.
lines.english: Notes are quite important. I read them once before doing homework every day.

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.hanzi: 这个方法真好！我以后也试试，希望能提高成绩。
lines.pinyin: Zhège fāngfǎ zhēn hǎo! Wǒ yǐhòu yě shìshi, xīwàng néng tígāo chéngjì.
lines.english: That is a great method. I will try it and hope to improve my grades.

texts.title: 先复习外语吧
texts.setting: 在教室里，刘小雪跟同学聊昨天的考试。

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.hanzi: 小雪，昨天的考试，你考得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Xiǎoxuě, zuótiān de kǎoshì, nǐ kǎo de zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: Xiaoxue, how did you do in yesterday’s exam?

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 我觉得历史有点儿难，你呢？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde lìshǐ yǒudiǎnr nán, nǐ ne?
lines.english: I thought history was a little difficult. What about you?

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.hanzi: 数学考试我没看清楚要求，做错了好几个题，考得挺差的。
lines.pinyin: Shùxué kǎoshì wǒ méi kàn qīngchu yāoqiú, zuòcuò le hǎo jǐ gè tí, kǎo de tǐng chà de.
lines.english: I did not read the maths instructions clearly, got several questions wrong and did rather poorly.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 明天还有考试呢，别想那么多了，先复习外语吧。
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān hái yǒu kǎoshì ne, bié xiǎng nàme duō le, xiān fùxí wàiyǔ ba.
lines.english: There is another exam tomorrow. Do not dwell on it; let us review the foreign language first.

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.hanzi: 外语作业里有几个问题，我可以问问你吗？
lines.pinyin: Wàiyǔ zuòyè li yǒu jǐ gè wèntí, wǒ kěyǐ wènwen nǐ ma?
lines.english: There are several questions in the foreign-language homework. May I ask you about them?

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 当然可以。在学习上，遇到什么问题都可以问我。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán kěyǐ. Zài xuéxí shang, yùdào shénme wèntí dōu kěyǐ wèn wǒ.
lines.english: Of course. You can ask me whenever you encounter a problem in your studies.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 不好意思，这几个题我也不会。咱们还是一起去办公室问问李老师吧。
lines.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, zhè jǐ gè tí wǒ yě bú huì. Zánmen háishì yìqǐ qù bàngōngshì wènwen Lǐ lǎoshī ba.
lines.english: Sorry, I cannot do these questions either. Let us go to the office and ask Teacher Li.

texts.title: 明天再把书还给我
texts.setting: 在李老师办公室，刘小雪跟同学问问题。
texts.editorialNote: 教材中文“我看重”与拼音 kàn bu dǒng、英文 don’t understand 矛盾；教材附注明确实际应为“我看不懂”。

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.hanzi: 李老师，书上有几个问题，我们想问问您。
lines.pinyin: Lǐ lǎoshī, shū shang yǒu jǐ gè wèntí, wǒmen xiǎng wènwen nín.
lines.english: Teacher Li, there are several questions in the book that we would like to ask you about.

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.hanzi: 好，坐下说吧，哪个题不会？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, zuòxia shuō ba, nǎge tí bú huì?
lines.english: All right, sit down. Which question do you not understand?

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.hanzi: 书上第五页的这个对话我看不懂，小雪也不明白。
lines.pinyin: Shū shang dì-wǔ yè de zhège duìhuà wǒ kàn bu dǒng, Xiǎoxuě yě bù míngbai.
lines.english: I do not understand the dialogue on page five, and Xiaoxue does not understand it either.

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.hanzi: 我课上讲过这几句话，再给你们讲一遍。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kè shang jiǎngguo zhè jǐ jù huà, zài gěi nǐmen jiǎng yí biàn.
lines.english: I explained these sentences in class; let me explain them once more.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.hanzi: 李老师给学生讲题。
lines.pinyin: Lǐ lǎoshī gěi xuésheng jiǎng tí.
lines.english: Teacher Li explains the questions to the students.

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.hanzi: 我终于懂了。这些句子一点儿也不难。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhōngyú dǒng le. Zhèxiē jùzi yìdiǎnr yě bù nán.
lines.english: I finally understand. These sentences are not difficult at all.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 我也明白了，谢谢您，李老师。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě míngbai le, xièxie nín, Lǐ lǎoshī.
lines.english: I understand too. Thank you, Teacher Li.

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.hanzi: 我这本书上还有几个练习，你们回家也做一做，明天再把书还给我。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhè běn shū shang hái yǒu jǐ gè liànxí, nǐmen huí jiā yě zuò yi zuò, míngtiān zài bǎ shū huán gěi wǒ.
lines.english: There are more exercises in my book. Do them at home and return the book to me tomorrow.

texts.title: 学习越来越忙
texts.author: 刘小雪
texts.setting: 在家里，刘小雪在写邮件。
texts.translationPolicy: 中文和拼音为教材原文；英文译文和教育体系说明为教学辅助。

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 家月姐姐：
lines.pinyin: Jiāyuè jiějie:
lines.english: Dear Jiayue,

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 你最近怎么样？忙不忙？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn zěnmeyàng? Máng bu máng?
lines.english: How have you been recently? Are you busy?

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 我现在上初中二年级，学习越来越忙，后年就要考高中了。中国的学校一般是小学六年，初中三年，高中三年。妈妈说想考上好大学，就得上一个好高中；为了考上好高中，初中就得有一个不错的成绩，所以我现在非常努力。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài shàng chūzhōng èr niánjí, xuéxí yuèláiyuè máng, hòunián jiù yào kǎo gāozhōng le. Zhōngguó de xuéxiào yìbān shì xiǎoxué liù nián, chūzhōng sān nián, gāozhōng sān nián. Māma shuō xiǎng kǎoshang hǎo dàxué, jiù děi shàng yí gè hǎo gāozhōng; wèile kǎoshang hǎo gāozhōng, chūzhōng jiù děi yǒu yí gè búcuò de chéngjì, suǒyǐ wǒ xiànzài fēicháng nǔlì.
lines.english: I am now in the second year of junior middle school. Study is getting busier, and the year after next I will take the senior high school entrance exam. Schools in China generally have six years of primary school, three years of junior middle school and three years of senior high school. Mum says that to enter a good university, I need to attend a good senior high school; to enter a good senior high school, I need good grades in junior middle school, so I am working very hard now.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 家月姐姐，你知道吗？在你的影响下，我也开始喜欢拍照了。下次你再来北京，我给你看看我照的照片。
lines.pinyin: Jiāyuè jiějie, nǐ zhīdào ma? Zài nǐ de yǐngxiǎng xià, wǒ yě kāishǐ xǐhuan pāizhào le. Xià cì nǐ zài lái Běijīng, wǒ gěi nǐ kànkan wǒ zhào de zhàopiàn.
lines.english: Jiayue, did you know? Under your influence, I have also started to enjoy taking photos. Next time you come to Beijing, I will show you the photos I have taken.

instructions.required: 完成“我的学习方法与成长计划”的当次准备卡；A和B保存的材料必须用于C。
instructions.optional: 不需要上传录音；课堂展示可以携带自己的笔记示例、问题卡或教育阶段图。
instructions.aiPolicy: 先独立回顾自己的学习方法和真实问题，再使用工具检查语言。

A.label: 我的学习方法 · 第1步
A.goal: 选择一门想提高的科目，用具体步骤说明怎样听课、记笔记和复习。
A.suggested_mix: 完成学习方法卡；保存一张笔记示例或示意图，供B、C继续使用。

B.label: 我的学习方法 · 第2步
B.goal: 记录一个具体学习问题、已经尝试的办法和清楚的求助表达。
B.suggested_mix: 在A的方法卡上增加问题求助卡和下一步行动。

C.label: 课堂最终项目 · 我的学习方法与成长计划
C.goal: 整合A/B，完成1—2分钟课堂分享。
C.suggested_mix: 不强制上传录音；可小组彩排，但每位学生都要说。

A.projectStage: 学习分享 1/3 · 选择科目
A.prompt_cn: 你最想提高哪一门课？你现在怎样听课、记笔记和复习？
A.prompt_en: Which subject do you most want to improve? How do you currently listen, take notes and review?
A.answerPlaceholder: 我想提高……。上课时我……。写作业以前我……。

A.projectStage: 学习分享 1/3 · 保存到最终展示
A.prompt_cn: 准备一张真实笔记、自己制作的示意图或不含隐私的学习图片，说明科目、目标和三个具体步骤。至少用一次位置改变的“把”字句。
A.prompt_en: Prepare one real note sample, your own diagram, or a privacy-safe study image. Explain the subject, goal and three concrete steps. Use one 把 sentence that describes where you put or record something.
A.answerPlaceholder: 科目：……。我想提高……。我认真……，把……记在……。写作业以前，我……。
picturePrompts: 一页不含私人信息的笔记或自制示意图

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core

A.projectStage: 下一次课 · Study Method Card
A.prompt_en: Prepare your study image and three-step routine.
presentationPlan: Bring one privacy-safe note sample, your own diagram, or a simple study image.
Be ready to answer: Which subject do you want to improve? What do you do before, during and after class?
Use at least four expressions from 数学, 认真, 笔记, 清楚, 黑板, 作业, 遍 and 提高.
Use one location-change 把 sentence, such as 把重点记在本子上. You may rehearse with a partner; no audio upload is required.
A.classroomNote: Keep this card. You will add a problem-and-help card in Homework B.

B.projectStage: 学习分享 2/3 · 发现具体问题
B.prompt_cn: 你最近在学习上遇到了什么具体问题？你已经试过什么办法？
B.prompt_en: What specific study problem have you encountered recently? What have you already tried?
B.answerPlaceholder: 在……上，我遇到……。我已经试过……，但是……。

B.projectStage: 学习分享 2/3 · 保存问题和下一步
B.prompt_cn: 在A的学习方法卡上增加一个具体问题：写清科目、页码或题号、困难点、已经尝试的办法，以及要向同学或老师提出的具体请求。
B.prompt_en: Add one specific problem to your Homework A card. State the subject, page or question number, difficulty, what you tried, and one clear request to a classmate or teacher.
B.answerPlaceholder: 在……上，我遇到……。第……页 / 第……题……。我试过……。请你 / 您……。
picturePrompts: 一道不含答案和姓名的问题示意图
已经尝试的方法与下一步

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 按句框写4—5句话，说明问题位置、困难和一个请求。

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 说明已经尝试的方法，并自然使用“在……上/中/下”中的一种。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 比较两种求助办法，解释哪一种更有效并提出后续检查方法。

B.projectStage: 下一次课 · Problem and Help Card
B.prompt_cn: Classroom Preparation: Problem and Help Card
B.prompt_en: Prepare one precise study problem and a clear request for help.
presentationPlan: Bring your Homework A card and one privacy-safe problem card or simple diagram.
Be ready to answer: What is the subject? Where is the problem? What did you try? What help do you need?
Use one of 在学习上, 在考试中 or 在……的帮助下, and give a page or question number when relevant.
Partners may role-play student and teacher. Keep personal grades private if you prefer; no audio upload is required.
B.classroomNote: Save the problem, request and next step. You will combine them with Homework A in the final presentation.

C.projectStage: 学习分享 3/3 · 组织展示
C.prompt_cn: 听众需要知道哪些信息，才能理解你的学习方法、问题、求助过程和下一阶段目标？
C.prompt_en: What does your audience need to understand your study method, problem, help-seeking process and next-stage goal?
C.answerPlaceholder: 听众需要知道科目、方法、问题、求助、改进和目标。

C.projectStage: 课堂大作业 · 我的学习方法与成长计划
C.prompt_cn: 整合A的学习方法卡和B的问题与求助卡，准备1—2分钟课堂分享。最后介绍自己的年级或学习阶段，并提出一个现实的下一步目标。
C.prompt_en: Combine your Study Method Card from A with your Problem and Help Card from B. Prepare a 1–2 minute class presentation. Finish by introducing your grade or study stage and one realistic next goal.
C.answerPlaceholder: 我现在学习……。我认真……，把……记在……。在学习上，我遇到……。在……的帮助下，我……。我把……交给 / 还给……。我现在上……年级，下一步准备……。
picturePrompts: 学习方法或笔记示意图
个人学习阶段和下一步目标

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 按句框完成6—7句话，说明一种方法、一个问题和一个目标。

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 独立组织1—2分钟分享，讲清方法、原因、求助和改进。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 评价方法的效果，比较求助前后的变化，并尊重地连接不同教育阶段。

C.projectStage: 最终回收 · My Study Method and Growth Plan
C.prompt_cn: Classroom Presentation: My Study Method and Growth Plan
C.prompt_en: Present your learning project mainly in class.
presentationPlan: Bring one to three images or diagrams plus your Study Method Card from A and Problem and Help Card from B.
Answer: What do you want to improve? What is your routine? What problem did you encounter? What did you try? Who helped? What is your next goal?
Use at least six lesson words and at least two lesson structures: a location-change 把 sentence, 在……上/中/下, or a transfer 把……给…… sentence.
If you compare school stages, present the textbook description as a general case and respect regional and personal differences.
Speak for 1–2 minutes. You may rehearse in pairs or small groups, but every student must speak. Audio upload is not required.
C.classroomNote: Use the saved work from A and B. Mistakes and weak points stay collapsed until you choose to review them.

focus: 我的学习方法与成长计划
